title: BMW M leads Korea's high-performance market, extends global streak

description: Starbucks Korea said Monday it is expanding its lineup of cake slices ahead of "Family Month" in May, as dessert preferences shift toward greater variety and personalization. title: Starbucks Korea expands sliced cake lineup as demand shifts to variety

description: South Korean stocks opened at a fresh high of over 6,700 on Monday as US President Donald Trump announced plans to free ships stranded in the Strait of Hormuz, while Washington and Tehran exchanged their proposals for peace talks. After opening at a fresh record high of 6,782.93, or 2.79 percent higher, the benchmark Korea Composite Stock Price Index added 157.3 points, or 2.38 percent, to 6,756.17 as of 9:15 a.m. The index had risen three straight sessions to close at an all-time high of 6,690.
